abstract: Best practices for @hellajs/router, the reactive routing package: router() configuration with nested routes, params, meta, redirects, and notFound; the route() signal (path, params, query, crumbs, active, pending); navigate() and href() with typed param substitution; before/after/leave guards including async deferral; history/hash/memory modes, scroll behavior, link interception, and resetRouter. Every rule is grounded in the package source and test suite.
